name: br-weather-radar-cappi
title: Brazilian Weather Radar Network - CAPPI
description: Collection of weather radar data from Brazilian ground-based radar networks, provided as Constant Altitude Plan Position Indicator (CAPPI) products. Depending on data availability for each radar, the collection may include multi-level CAPPI data with 15 constant-altitude levels from 2 to 16 km (1 km vertical resolution), single-level CAPPI data at 3 km altitude, or only a thumbnail representation. CAPPI data contain radar reflectivity fields expressed in dBZ, with a horizontal spatial resolution of 1 km. The data are produced by radar networks operated by several Brazilian institutions and are integrated, processed and hosted by the National Institute for Space Research (INPE).

Fundação Cearense de Meteorologia e Recursos Hídricos (Funceme)
Departamento de Controle do Espaço Aéreo (DECEA)
National Institute for Space Research (INPE)
providers.processing:lineage: The Constant Altitude Plan Position Indicator, better known as CAPPI, is a radar display that provides a horizontal cross-section of radar data at a constant altitude. CAPPI data are generated by interpolating the volume scan onto a Cartesian grid. Fifteen CAPPI levels are provided, ranging from 2 to 15 km. 3-km CAPPI represents the radar data at 3 km above mean sea level. Units are dBZ.

bands.name: cappi
bands.description: Radar reflectivity expressed in dBZ, represented using the Constant Altitude Plan Position Indicator (CAPPI).

cappi15l.title: Multi-level CAPPI
cappi15l.description: NetCDF file containing radar reflectivity fields for 15 CAPPI levels at distinct constant altitudes (2 to 16 km, vertical resolution of 1 km).

cappi3km.title: CAPPI - 3 km
cappi3km.description: NetCDF file containing radar reflectivity expressed in dBZ for a single CAPPI level at 3 km altitude.
